title: Ford Chombo v The Attorney General (2025/CCZ/008) [2025] ZMCC 11 (19 June 2025)
case_name: Ford Chombo v The Attorney General
issue_tags: Constitution of Zambia (Amendment) Act No. 2 of 2016
labour matter outside Constitutional Court jurisdiction
outcome_detail: Petition filed 28 March 2025 dismissed; Article 189(2) does not operate retrospectively (only came into force 5 January 2016); petitioner retired 1 March 2013 — pre-2016 dispute is a labour matter outside the Constitutional Court's jurisdiction; each party to bear own costs
